name: Mysterious Youth
source:
An unusually strong inhuman.
One of a race of monsters called vampires.
For some reason he's attached to the protagonist and is after her life.
He transfers into her school under the name of 'Shiga Takashi'.
Hobby/Special Skill: Piano
